blocks.text: 102 3585 146A STREET King George Corridor Surrey V4P 1B2

parts.t: Welcome to Forest Ridge! Enjoy this 2 bedroom + Den ground level unit which offers high end Samsung appliances, heated bathroom floors, his & hers sinks in the ensuite, full AC, and so much more! Outside includes a huge retractable glass solarium with a gas BBQ connection along with a large outdoor patio & a private fenced yard! Amenities include a rentable guest suite, rec room with pool table, media room, and fitness facility, 2 parking stalls & a large storage unit. Located minutes from Crescent Beach, all your needed shops, along with the HWY 99 this unit truly is a gem! **Subject Free Accepted Offer - Rescission Period until January 25th at 11:59 PM.**
